topics.title_zh: 勒文·阿尔伯格黎曼猜想证明引发AI与人类对抗
topics.title_en: Levent Alpöge’s Riemann Proof Sparks Human vs. AI Tensions
topics.summary_zh: 数学家勒文·阿尔伯格利用Claude模型完成黎曼猜想证明，不仅通过1700万行Lean代码验证，更发布AI辅助的纳维-斯托克斯解法补丁。然而，斯坦福大学学者随即发布人类独立证明草案，质疑AI推导的逻辑严密性与物理直觉，形成AI辅助证明与传统学术权威的直接冲击。
topics.summary_en: Mathematician Levent Alpöge used Claude to proof the Riemann Hypothesis, verified by 17M lines of Lean code, and corrected OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes solution. However, Stanford scholars countered with an all-human proof, challenging the logical depth of AI-assisted derivations and signaling a collision between automated verification and traditional academic rigor.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进派 / 计算数学支持者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 通过形式化验证的AI证明消除了人为计算的谬误，Lean代码作为客观裁判，证明了AI在处理极高复杂度逻辑推理上的代际领先优势。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI-driven formal verification via Lean eliminates human error, demonstrating that machine-assisted logic can resolve complex conjectures far beyond human endurance.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 学术传统主义者
perspective_con.point_zh: AI证明缺乏对数学本质物理意义的直觉洞察，仅是通过穷举与概率填充逻辑闭环，过度依赖形式化工具可能导致数学研究失去创造性灵魂。
perspective_con.point_en: AI proofs lack the intuitive grasp of physical meaning, relying on brute-force logic. Over-reliance on formalization risks stripping math of its creative, intuitive core.

topics.title_zh: AI泡沫破灭：纳指单周暴跌10.4%与服务器供应链溢价
topics.title_en: AI Bubble Burst: Nasdaq Plummets 10.4% Amid Server Cost Crisis
topics.summary_zh: 美科技股遭遇疫情以来最严重周跌幅，纳指陷入熊市区。核心动因在于AI服务器供应吃紧导致厂商违约提价45%，企业高昂的算力资本支出与滞后的盈利回笼形成反差。同时，美商务部将芯片出口管制门槛下调至14纳米，严重冲击全球消费电子供应链，引发市场恐慌性抛售。
topics.summary_en: Tech stocks suffered their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as suppliers hike server prices by 45% post-contract. High CAPEX coupled with slow ROI is triggering market fears. Meanwhile, the expansion of US export controls to 14nm nodes threatens consumer electronics, exacerbating the sell-off.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 基建扩张派 / 英伟达生态拥护者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 算力短缺是工业革命初期的阵痛，高溢价反映了AGI时代的生产力通胀，率先占据算力基础设施的机构将获得未来十年的赢家地位。
perspective_pro.point_en: Shortages are early industrial growing pains. The 45% premium reflects the necessity of compute in the AGI era; those who secure capacity now dominate the next decade.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 风险控制派 / 市场质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 金融分析师与卖方研究员
perspective_con.point_zh: 服务器违约涨价和供应链禁令暴露了AI产业的脆弱性，高额融资无法在缺乏落地应用支撑的前提下无限期维持，泡沫正在回吐。
perspective_con.point_en: Supply chain instability and escalating costs expose the fragility of the AI model. Without clear downstream profitability, the capital expenditure bubble is inevitably bursting.

@Acurast 采取了另一条路线：超过 175 个国家/地区的 36 万多部手机，每部手机均由内置的安全芯片进行验证。没有单个云帐户需要暂停。

我的荣耀X7d就是其中一款手机。它位于我的办公桌上，有助于保持网络运行。

您会将您的人工智能代理信任给一家云提供商吗？
linked_tweets.content_en:
3 companies hold 61% of the world's cloud. When one of them goes down, every AI agent running on it stops too. We saw it on Nov 12, when a Microsoft outage took Outlook, Teams and Copilot offline in 74 countries for 12+ hours.

@Acurast takes another route: 360K+ phones in 175+ countries, each verified by the secure chip already inside it. No single cloud account to suspend.

My HONOR X7d is one of those phones. It sits on my desk and helps keep that network running.

Would you trust your AI agent to one cloud provider?

topics.title_zh: 字节跳动挑战超长上下文：开源循环模型Inkling 2 Mini
topics.title_en: Bytedance Challenges Context Window Obsession with Inkling 2 Mini
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达研究指出超长上下文是效率死胡同，字节跳动随之发布开源模型并提出精简训练范式。Thinking Machines推出的Inkling 2 Mini通过层循环推理（Thinking in loops），以极低计算资源在笔记本端实现复杂逻辑处理，直接挑战了OpenAI GPT-6.2依赖超大参数堆叠的路径。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia researchers argue massive context windows are a dead end. Bytedance counters with a lean training paradigm, while Thinking Machines debuts Inkling 2 Mini—a looping transformer that enables complex reasoning on laptops, defying the 'bigger is better' model scaling laws of OpenAI's GPT-6.2.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 效率优化派 / 边缘计算支持者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 模型性能不应依赖暴力堆叠Token，循环思考机制模拟了人类反思的迭代过程，是解决复杂任务最轻量且低碳的可持续途径。
perspective_pro.point_en: Performance shouldn't rely on brute-force token scaling. Loop-based reasoning mimics human iteration, offering the most energy-efficient path to complex problem solving.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 规模效应派 / 暴力美学支持者
perspective_con.point_zh: 循环模型在长程依赖处理上仍有物理瓶颈，超长上下文提供的是“全局记忆”，这是递归层级永远无法完全替代的智力深度。
perspective_con.point_en: Looping models face physical limitations in long-range dependency, whereas massive context provides 'global memory' that recursion cannot replicate in intellectual depth.

linked_tweets.author: Faustino
linked_tweets.content_zh:
将人工智能代理转移到另一台机器听起来很简单。保持其记忆和决策完整是一个不同的挑战。

这是一个被忽视的问题，值得与 @Acurast 一起探索。

想象一下在智能手机处理器上运行的交易代理。它跟踪未平仓头寸、风险限额和待处理交易。

如果该处理器脱机，在其他地方重新启动相同的代码并不一定能恢复代理正在执行的操作。

这就是代码可移植性和状态可移植性之间的区别。

Acurast 提供分布式、可验证的执行，但开发人员仍然需要持久的存储和恢复逻辑来跨部署保留代理的状态。

对我来说，这就是去中心化人工智能基础设施变得更有趣的地方。

在任何地方运行代理都是有用的。确保它可以安全地从中断处继续，使这种灵活性变得切实可行。
linked_tweets.content_en:
Moving an AI agent to another machine sounds simple. Keeping its memory and decisions intact is a different challenge.

This is an overlooked question worth exploring with @Acurast .

Imagine a trading agent running on a smartphone Processor. It tracks open positions, risk limits, and pending transactions.

If that Processor goes offline, restarting the same code elsewhere doesn't necessarily restore what the agent was doing.

That's the difference between code portability and state portability.

Acurast provides distributed, verifiable execution, but developers still need durable storage and recovery logic to preserve an agent's state across deployments.

To me, this is where decentralized AI infrastructure becomes more interesting.

Running an agent anywhere is useful. Making sure it can safely continue where it left off is what makes that flexibility practical.
